about.title: About
about.subtitle: Software Engineer
about.description1: I have experience building both backend (Go, PostgreSQL) and frontend (React, Angular). At AIPower I work in a team on a logistics & warehouse management platform for a Japanese company and own three modules, taking part in design, client communication, coding and testing.
about.description2: I also have experience building Angular/TypeScript frontends for F&B software products at F2Tech, working in Agile/Scrum.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.summary: Team member on a logistics & warehouse management platform for a Japanese logistics company. I own three main modules, taking part in design, client communication, coding and testing.

items.label: Stocktaking
items.text: Snapshot-based count sessions, CSV import, discrepancy reconciliation, CSV/PDF export, automatic stock adjustment, audit log.

items.label: Amazon shipping
items.text: Amazon SP-API integration: import orders, get rates, buy and print shipping labels.

items.label: Japanese carrier
items.text: Label issuance, handover documents, carrier error handling. Accepted by the client.

items.label: Operations
items.text: Daily client tickets, data checks in SQL, code review, staging deployments.

jobs.note: All three modules are covered by unit and user-journey tests. I use AI (Claude, Codex, Gemini, MiniMax) to help write code and tests.

jobs.title: Front-End Developer
jobs.summary: Built features for four F&B software products from Figma designs and REST APIs.

items.label: Quick BI Report
items.text: Added report charts with Syncfusion; RxJS optimizations cut page load time by about 20%.

items.label: Quick Booking
items.text: Multi-brand table booking landing page from one codebase; UTM tracking, Google Analytics.

items.label: E-menu & Catalog
items.text: Upgraded the digital menu UI and browsing flow.
